{{Quote|So predictable, you Jedi. I organize a prison riot, and you come running all the way across the galaxy... Just so I can kill you.|[[Durge/Legends|Durge]]|<ref name="Means and Ends" />}}
The '''riot at the M'Bardi Prison''' occurred on the planet [[M'Bardi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] instigated a riot at the [[M'Bardi Prison]], hoping to attract [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to kill. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] eventually showed up, trying to recapture all the escaped [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. After the Jedi had fought off several prisoners, Durge revealed himself by shooting [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] at the two. He then engaged Fisto and Koon in close combat while boasting about how his plan had worked. Both his arms were cut off, but thanks to his [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] physiology he was still able to subdue the Masters. As he strangled them, he was shot in the chest by an [[Xamus/Sumax|intervening prisoner]]. The Jedi took advantage of his surprise, escaping and trapping the bounty hunter in the lower levels of the prison, though Fisto remarked that such a confinement would not hold him for long. Until reinforcements could arrive, the Jedi Masters headed back to the rioting prisoners and took Xamus/Sumax with them to watch their backs, offering him a second chance by earning time off for good behavior.<ref name="Means and Ends" />
